record.paper_title: Billiard dynamics: A survey with the emphasis on open problems
record.context_brief: Positive entropy in C2 convex billiards
record.original_question: Does there exist a convex C2-smooth planar billiard table whose billiard dynamics has positive entropy?

evidence.quote: b) Построить выпуклый C2-гладкий биллиардный стол с положительной энтропией.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider a planar billiard table given by a strictly convex bounded region $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^2$ whose boundary $\partial\Omega$ is a $C^2$-smooth simple closed curve. The billiard dynamics on $\Omega$ is the discrete-time map $T$ acting on the phase space of unit vectors based at points of $\partial\Omega$ pointing into $\Omega$, where $T$ sends a state to the next collision point and reflected direction obtained by the law of equal angles. Let $h_{\mathrm{top}}(T)$ denote the topological entropy of this map (equivalently, one may consider the metric entropy with respect to the invariant Liouville-type measure on the phase space).

Question: Does there exist a strictly convex planar billiard table with $C^2$-smooth boundary such that $h_{\mathrm{top}}(T) > 0$?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem has been resolved positively. Recent work (Berger–Turaev, "Billiards in generic convex bodies have positive topological entropy", Advances in Mathematics 2024; arXiv:2201.01362) shows that a C2-open and dense set of strictly convex smooth planar billiards exhibits a hyperbolic basic set and consequently positive topological entropy and exponential growth of periodic orbits. In particular, examples of C2-smooth convex billiard tables with positive entropy exist.

status_evidence.title: Billiards in generic convex bodies have positive topological entropy
status_evidence.snippet: A C2 open dense set of convex bodies with smooth boundary has billiard maps with non-trivial hyperbolic basic sets; consequently, billiards in generic convex bodies have positive topological entropy.
status_evidence.claim: There exist (in fact generically) C2 convex planar billiards with positive topological entropy.

status_evidence.title: Billiards in generic convex bodies have positive topological entropy - ScienceDirect
status_evidence.snippet: Published in Advances in Mathematics (2024); proves positive topological entropy for a C2-generic set of convex billiards.
status_evidence.claim: Affirmative answer to the existence of C2 convex billiards with positive entropy.
